title: U S PHYSICAL THERAPY INC /NV 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: U.S. Physical Therapy, Inc. entered into a Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent on April 14, 2026. The facility provides $450 million in total credit ($275M revolving, $175M term) maturing April 14, 2031, with pricing at Term SOFR plus 1.25%-2.25% based on leverage ratios.
key_points: Company is a national operator of outpatient physical therapy clinics and industrial injury prevention services
Credit syndicate includes Bank of America (administrative agent), BofA Securities, Regions Capital Markets, U.S. Bank, JPMorgan Chase, Citizens Bank, and BankUnited
Revolving facility: $275 million with $25M sublimit for standby letters of credit and $25M for swingline loans
Term facility: $175 million with quarterly amortization of 0.625% years 1-2, 1.25% years 3-4, 1.875% year 5
Interest rate: Term SOFR plus applicable margin of 1.25% to 2.25% (leverage-based pricing grid)
Unfunded commitment fee: 0.225% to 0.35% per annum based on leverage ratio
Proceeds of revolving facility for working capital, acquisitions, and growth; term facility to refinance prior agreement and pay transaction fees
